name: 8991-sharedprefix-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct -- an ungated re-upload of the gated `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct` (same weights; config.json matches on every shape field). 15.0 GiB over four safetensors.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads at head_dim 128, hidden 4096, bf16 -- 128 KiB of KV per token at TP1.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 960 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, seed 42: one of four distinct 32768-token context blocks emitted as the request `prefix`, plus a unique ~256-token query (stdev 64, clamped 128-512), generating ~64 tokens (stdev 16, clamped 32-128) -- ~33k input tokens per request.
purpose: An 8B chat assistant answering short questions against four large shared document contexts, eight concurrent users, one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. sglang 0.5.0rc0-era server args.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
context-length: 36864
mem-fraction-static: 0.85

# The engine takes the MIN of the profiled KV pool and this cap and only logs a warning, so check
# the startup log reports max_total_num_tokens = 262144. A smaller pool is a different setup:
# raise mem-fraction-static until the profiled value clears the cap, do not lower the cap.
max-total-tokens: 262144

enable-hierarchical-cache: true
hicache-size: 40
random-seed: 42
